The Indianapolis Motor Speedway, in Indiana, USA, has a permanent seated capacity of 235,000 – reduced from 257,325 in 2013 – and covers 253 acres (102.3 ha). Including non-seated spectators, it can accommodate more than 350,000 fans. Built in 1909, the stadium is home to the famous “Indy 500” and “Brickyard 400” races and contains a 4.09-km (2.5‑m) oval-format race circuit.
